paper.title: Replica symmetry up to the de Almeida–Thouless line in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model
paper.author: Patrick Lopatto

coverage_note: All 15 numbered results and all 58 substantive supporting entries have closed Lean formalizations. Historical literature-survey assertions are listed separately as external background.

numbered_results.statement: For β>0,h>0, an RS fixed point q∈[0,1], and α≤1, F(β,h)=Φ_RS(β,h).
numbered_results.proved_scope: The actual finite SK free energy converges throughout the closed AT region. Both the complete actual PDE→G→JT→Parisi-formula proof following the paper and a separately audited strict-region approximation proof are available.

numbered_results.statement: The positive-field AT boundary is a strictly increasing C∞ graph on β>1, tending to zero at β=1+.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Complete actual Gaussian boundary-set equality, C-infinity increasing positive-field graph on beta>1, and right endpoint limit zero. Smoothness is ContDiff order infinity, not analyticity.

numbered_results.statement: Existence, uniqueness, regularity and derivative bounds for the weak Parisi PDE.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Unique continuous weak potential on the closed strip in the original admissible weak class; actual selected weak solution; all positive spatial derivatives jointly continuous and bounded; every weak time derivative of every spatial order measurable and uniformly bounded; sharp first/second derivative bounds. Measurable gradients are unique almost everywhere.

numbered_results.statement: The SK thermodynamic free energy is the infimum of the Parisi functional.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Physical finite-volume SK convergence to the infimum over ALL actual probability measures on [0,1] of the constructed weak-PDE functional. Finite-step Talagrand backend is bridged to arbitrary measures by actual probability quantization, CDF L1 estimates, global mild convergence, and exact finite-step functional identification.

numbered_results.statement: A Parisi measure minimizes the functional iff every support point minimizes its variational function.
numbered_results.proved_scope: For every actual probability measure, minimization of the actual PDE functional is equivalent to the actual topological support lying in the global argmin of the actual selected state-based G. Actual functional mixing convexity, HJB envelope, optimal-gradient martingale, first variation, and support deductions are all discharged.

numbered_results.statement: Explicit piecewise PDE solution, state SDE and Gaussian law at time q for μ=δq.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Actual arbitrary-measure PDE selector at delta_q equals both explicit heat/Cole-Hopf formulas, including gradient/Hessian and both closed endpoints. Actual selected general strong Brownian state equals the Dirac state path by path, satisfies both drift equations, and has the stated Gaussian interface law.
Exact quantitative lower bound for the actual selected PDE-gradient second moment along the actual Brownian state. No supplied Poincare or state-law premise.

numbered_results.statement: dm=β(1−m²)dW and the second-moment derivative equals β²E[(1−m²)²], initially q.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Actual selected-state magnetization change is the limit in probability of genuine adapted Brownian left sums with coefficient beta(1-m^2). Actual moment derivative on the entire closed interval, initial fixed-point moment, and literal right/left endpoint derivatives are proved.
Actual selected general-PDE Dirac moment is bounded by time under the exact small-complement and fixed-point inputs; no AT assumption.
Exact structural strict field bound from actual positive-field fixed point and large complement variance; no AT assumption.

numbered_results.statement: The post-q transition kernel is exp(−λ/2)Pλ(cosh·ψ)(x)/cosh x.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Conditional expectation for every bounded measurable observable of the actual selected state, in the actual Brownian natural filtration, equals the explicit normalized cosh-Gaussian transition expression, including elapsed time zero. The wrapper also asserts the genuine Markov probability kernel and its explicit integral formula for every starting x, including zero variance.

numbered_results.statement: For h≤β²q and α≤1, E[m_t²]≤t, strictly when t>q.
numbered_results.proved_scope: Actual selected general-PDE Dirac moment has the requested non-strict bound on the closed interval and strict bound after q under the explicit small-field hypothesis.
Actual selected general-PDE Dirac moment is bounded by time in both regimes under the physical AT hypotheses.

numbered_results.statement: The Dirac variational function Gδq is globally minimized at q.
numbered_results.proved_scope: The genuine arbitrary-measure selected observable G_delta_q has its global minimum at q. The separately proved minimum is strict away from q.

numbered_results.statement: The unique Parisi minimizer is exactly δq.
numbered_results.proved_scope: The actual Dirac q is a PDE-functional minimizer, and every actual PDE-functional minimizer equals it under the physical closed AT hypotheses. Actual strict G minimum and mixing first variation prove uniqueness without assuming general functional strict convexity.

supporting_results.statement: For β>0,h>0 the scalar Gaussian fixed point exists uniquely.
A positive-field nonnegative fixed point satisfies 0<q<1.
The bounded tanh-square and sech-power Gaussian observables are integrable.
0≤overlapMap<1, with overlapMap(β,h,0)=tanh²h.
For β≠0, 0<α≤β².
tanh²x+sech²x=1.
(tanh)′=sech².
(sech)′=−sech·tanh and (sech²)′=−2tanh·sech².
For y≠0, tanh(y)(tanh(y)−y sech²(y))>0.
For 0≤c≤1 and x≥0, c tanh(cx)≤tanh x.
sech³ is even and decreasing with absolute value.
P₀ is the identity.
The RS spatial derivatives agree continuously at q.
supporting_results.proved_scope: The actual explicit soft potential and its first two spatial derivatives match the hard formulas and extend continuously to the interface. This does not identify the weak PDE solution.

supporting_results.statement: Before q, u_x(t,X_t)=E[tanh(X_q)|𝓕_t].
supporting_results.proved_scope: Literal before-q conditional expectation of terminal tanh is the actual PDE gradient along the actual selected strong state. The general actual optimal-gradient process is also a genuine Mathlib martingale on the closed physical strip.

supporting_results.statement: q−E[u_x(t,X_t)²]≤α(q−t).
supporting_results.proved_scope: Literal conditional variance is bounded almost everywhere by beta²(q−t) times the actual conditional sech-fourth expectation. The exact total conditional-variance decomposition is proved for the actual selected state and actual PDE-gradient moment, including both endpoints.

supporting_results.statement: E[m_t²]=q+β²∫q^tE[(1−m_s²)²]ds.
At every positive variance t, h ↦ E[tanh²(h+sqrt(t)Z)] is strictly increasing on h≥0.
supporting_results.proved_scope: Nondecrease is proved by density reflection; strict increase at positive variance is proved from the actual derivative and positive odd moment.

supporting_results.statement: For Y=σ²+σZ, E[Y tanh Y]=σ².
Lφ=(cosh·φ)″/(2cosh)−φ/2.
Pλ cosh=exp(λ/2)cosh.
w(x)=(p(x)+p(−x))/(2cosh x) decreases in |x| when h≤σ².
The double integral is absolutely convergent for integrable w and bounded k.
Two functions decreasing with absolute value give a nonnegative difference product.
a₂(λ)≤exp(−λ/2)a₂(0).
The actual hard and selected Dirac second moments satisfy the literal integrated exponential envelope q + (2 alpha / beta^2)(1-exp(-beta^2(t-q)/2)), yielding strict comparison after q.
supporting_results.proved_scope: The concrete physical and selected-state exponential envelope is proved under beta nonzero, q in [0,1], h nonnegative, h <= beta^2*q and the actual fixed point. The q=0 boundary is included by a separate genuine heat bound.

supporting_results.statement: P(δq)=Φ_RS through the exact correction integral.
A_h=−2u,C_h=−4v,A_t=2A−3C,C_t=2(hv−T)/t.
supporting_results.proved_scope: All listed field and variance derivative identities are proved for the concrete Gaussian observables; variance derivatives require t>0.

supporting_results.statement: The AT equations correspond to tC+A−1=0, with β=1/√C and q=tC.
For h>0,t>0, u,v,B,T are positive; B−T>0.
supporting_results.proved_scope: Actual U,V are positive at positive h,t. Actual T,B,B-T are positive at positive t, with arbitrary h for the last three.

supporting_results.statement: F_h<0,F_t>0 and h′>0 from the appendix sign identities.
On the zero set, 2tB−hu=tC−E[Yms]>0.
supporting_results.proved_scope: The actual mixed-moment Stein identity and exact strictly positive zero-set gap are proved.

supporting_results.statement: dC/dt=−2[uT+v(2tB−hu)]/[t(u+2tv)]<0.
h(t) and β(t) increase strictly; C(h(t),t) decreases strictly.
h(t)→0 and β(t)→1 as t→0+; β(t)→∞ as t→∞.
supporting_results.proved_scope: The actual selected field and beta curves satisfy all three stated endpoint limits and the bound beta(t)^2>t.

supporting_results.statement: β maps (0,∞) smoothly and bijectively onto (1,∞), with smooth inverse.
The actual Gaussian heat kernel is measurable, symmetric, nonnegative, and has unit row mass at positive variance.
The actual paper weight and sech-cube satisfy Gaussian heat contraction, including strict radial contraction and the exact Gaussian Doob decay bound.
The concrete Gaussian cosh transform is positive, constant-preserving, bounded on bounded measurable functions, identity at zero variance, and has the exact heat-kernel form.
For Y=s+sqrt(s)Z, mean/variance matching yields E[Y]=s, E[Y^2]=s+s^2, E[Y tanh Y]=s, and the actual expectation Cauchy-Schwarz bound.
The concrete finite SK Hamiltonian, Boltzmann factors, partition function, and log partition are integrable, and the partition function is strictly positive.
Probability measures on [0,1], their CDF correction integrability, and exact Dirac CDF/support/correction are concrete and proved.
Dominated scale differentiation, Stein-based Gaussian variance differentiation, and joint continuity of A,C,F, including variance zero, are implemented without assumed derivative-exchange identities.
supporting_results.proved_scope: Complete concrete derivative-exchange and joint continuity proofs, including continuity at variance zero.

supporting_results.statement: Positive-mean Gaussian expectations of continuous odd positive-halfline observables are positive; the actual appendix u,v moments instantiate the theorem.
supporting_results.proved_scope: Complete density-reflection and actual positive odd-observable expectation proofs.

supporting_results.statement: At each positive variance there is exactly one positive Gaussian zero; its field coordinate is strictly increasing and continuous, and the full boundary is its beta/field image plus (1,0).
Actual original admissible weak-class well-posedness, with potential equality everywhere on the closed strip and gradient equality almost everywhere.
Every positive spatial derivative is jointly continuous and bounded, every spatial order has a bounded measurable weak time derivative, and sharp gradient/Hessian bounds hold.
Actual canonical Brownian pathwise Picard solution with the actual Parisi gradient; all bounded Lipschitz/adapted/Ito premises discharged.
Actual finite atomic grid laws, CDF L1 mesh bound, global bounded mild gradient convergence, and potential/correction convergence.
Finite-step Talagrand formula is identified with the actual arbitrary-measure weak PDE variational infimum and actual physical Hamiltonian signs/normalization.
The actual selected PDE functional is convex on every genuine mixing segment.
Actual general PDE selector, strong state, second moment, and G at Dirac law agree with their explicit RS counterparts.
The actual state-based G at Dirac q has a strict unique minimum at q under physical AT hypotheses, sufficient for the unique-minimizer remark once the first variation is proved.

Volterra heat potential and its actual spatial derivative are jointly continuous on the physical strip for merely measurable uniformly bounded source, recovering the original weak class without assuming source-time continuity.
For every physical starting time t and spatial point x, the actual weak PDE potential u_mu(t,x) is the value of the corresponding stochastic control problem.
supporting_results.proved_scope: For every actual probability measure, beta nonzero, starting time a in [0,1] and x real, the actual potential equals the supremum of the explicitly integrated fresh-Brownian objectives over bounded continuous adapted controls. Its actual restarted PDE feedback is admissible and attains the value. The terminal starting time a=1 is included.

supporting_results.statement: For every actual measure, the selected optimal PDE gradient along its selected strong state is a genuine martingale; all later gradients have conditional expectation equal to the earlier gradient.
The actual PDE functional along every genuine probability mixing path has right derivative equal to the integral of actual selected state-based G against nu minus mu.
The actual Dirac Parisi potential is classical C^{1,2} on each side of q, with physical one-sided time derivatives at the strip endpoints and continuous spatial derivatives across q.
supporting_results.proved_scope: Actual selected potential, beta>0 and q in [0,1]. First time derivatives are jointly continuous on the two open pieces, with genuine within-strip derivatives at t=0 and t=1 when off-interface. Actual spatial C-infinity strengthens the C^2 requirement. No time derivative at q is asserted.
